Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

Keep the supplied language.", "input": "i'm preparing the subtitle file for the harbor lights concert at the old ferry hall on friday and the venue manager asked me to check the invoice against the production notes the actual cost was 145.03 not 77.76 because the smaller figure came from an early estimate before the extra caption review was added

 the file covers the opening remarks the three songs and the encore and the singer's name is mara vale the subtitle track begins before the doors opened at six fifteen and the first line has to stay on screen while the stage lights are still down

 i checked the timing against the audio recording and moved the line about the late train two seconds later so it does not cover the applause the balcony camera caught a reflection on the right side of the screen but that reflection is not part of the subtitle file the last subtitle ends after the band leaves the stage and before the house lights come up

 i saved the revised file in the shared concert folder and left the invoice scan beside it so the editor can compare the total the manager also asked me to keep the original version in the folder because the caption reviewer may need to check the earlier timing", "output": "I'm preparing the subtitle file for the Harbor Lights concert at the Old Ferry Hall on Friday, and the venue manager asked me to check the invoice against the production notes. The file covers the opening remarks, the three songs, and the encore, and the singer's name is Mara Vale. The subtitle track begins before the doors opened at six fifteen, and the first line has to stay on screen while the stage lights are still down.

The balcony camera caught a reflection on the right side of the screen, but that reflection is not part of the subtitle file. The last subtitle ends after the band leaves the stage and before the house lights come up.

I saved the revised file in the shared concert folder and left the invoice scan beside it so the editor can compare the total. The manager also asked me to keep the original version in the folder because the caption reviewer may need to check the earlier timing."}]
